headline: Taylor Farms to Remove Products After Lettuce Is Linked to Cyclospora Cases
context: The California company grows produce in more than 12 states, and in Mexico and Canada. Taco Bell and food distributor Sysco have pulled Taylor Farms lettuce from supply chains.
